newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM tight-lipped on Iberia alliance talk.
newsitem.headline: KLM tight-lipped on Iberia alliance talk.

text.p: Dutch carrier KLM on Tuesday declined comment on reports it could be gearing up for an alliance with Spain's Iberia.
"These are rumours, and KLM does not comment on rumours," spokesman Maurits Kalff said.

Spanish newspaper El Mundo said at the weekend KLM was close to a partnership deal with Iberia. The alliance speculation was fuelled by news on Monday the Spanish flag carrier returned to profit in the first half of 1996 for the first time since 1989.
KLM has said in the past it is looking for a strong partner to increase market share on its European routes.
Spanish industry watchers have said the Dutch flag carrier is seen as attractive to Iberia because it would enable it to consolidate its position on the Latin American market.
However, Iberia is also seen linking up in a three-way mega-deal with British Airways and AMR Corp's American Airlines.
